subject.title: [Feature]: Diffs viewer: per-file +/- stats and multi-file summary navigation

question: Should the Diffs plugin ship the linked SSR changed-files summary/navigation and PNG/PDF toolbar suppression as the intended viewer/export UX?
rationale: The implementation is bounded, but this is a protected maintainer-labeled feature that changes user-visible viewer and static artifact output.

options.title: Review And Land The Candidate PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100753 as the active implementation path after maintainer UX review and sufficient visual/export proof.

options.title: Narrow The Scope
options.body: Approve only the multi-file summary/navigation or only the static-export cleanup if maintainers want separate design review.

options.title: Defer The Feature
options.body: Keep this issue open as backlog if Diffs viewer ergonomics are not a current priority.

recommendation.title: Review And Land The Candidate PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100753 as the active implementation path after maintainer UX review and sufficient visual/export proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He opened the feature request and linked candidate PR and has prior Diffs plugin history.
